_readme: Ticket agents (lib/ticket_agents.py). mode: auto = propose until act_after, then act | propose | act | off. agents: per-agent override. stale_claims and refeed were propose-only at first (releasing a claim can re-queue a ticket someone meant to hold: label it held; a rework updates the same PR, mr_raiser, so refeed opens no duplicate). A ticket labelled pinned is never touched; held also protects its claim. project_tag acts from the start (Gil 2026-10-08, ADR 0060): it only adds a project: label, never removes one, never re-adds one a person took off, and every change is in the audit log. triage acts from 2026-10-09 (Gil: 53 open tickets had no state, so nothing flowed). prioritize, stale_claims and refeed act from 2026-10-09 too (Gil: step 0 of the road to green, docs/life-of-a-ticket.md); a ticket labelled held keeps its claim, pinned is never touched.
